svg.title: Workshop cards: keep the expressive exception and restore the booking inset
svg.desc: Only the complete left booking band moves right by 34 units, from x45 to x79. It regains the 14-unit card inset used by the right booking band. The left guest-session photo retains its intentional 20-unit protrusion beyond the card edge at x65 in both versions. Every word, type style, band dimension, other position, image source/crop, paper and lighting stays fixed. Original fictional printed workshop sheet.
